Municipal IPTU and ITBI Tax Revenue

Source: R/data-siconfi_taxes.R
siconfi_taxes.Rd

Annual municipal IPTU and ITBI revenue in nominal BRL from SICONFI/FINBRA DCA Annex I-C, 2013-present, with the 2018 account-vintage break marked by account_scope; the Distrito Federal (5300108) is excluded because it reports IPTU and ITBI only in its state-level accounts.

Retrieve this dataset with get_dataset() using the name "siconfi_taxes".

siconfi_taxes <- get_dataset("siconfi_taxes")

Source

Tesouro Nacional - SICONFI (DCA, Anexo I-C), FINBRA bulk files, and IBGE population

Details

  • Source: Tesouro Nacional - SICONFI (DCA, Anexo I-C), FINBRA bulk files, and IBGE population

  • URL: https://apidatalake.tesouro.gov.br/ords/siconfi/tt/entes

  • Geography: Brazilian municipalities

  • Frequency: annual

  • Coverage: 2013-latest closed year

  • Access mode: materialized

This dataset is cache-only: it is rebuilt by data-raw/siconfi/build_snapshot.R from the maintainer's local FINBRA bulk files (never in the repository) plus an API refresh of the latest years, so source='fresh' and the fresh half of source='auto' do not apply. Values are nominal BRL with a decimal-comma source parsed to the cent; the 2013 FINBRA files include municipalities that filed QDCC instead of DCA (São Paulo among them), accepted as published. The 2018 PCASP recode folds fines and old-debt lines into the tax parents, so the pre-2018 tax line is not comparable with the post-2018 tax family; account_scope marks the break and no cross-break total is reconstructed. The Distrito Federal (5300108) is excluded from the municipality universe because it reports IPTU and ITBI in its state-level accounts and never in the municipal files. FUNDEB and constitutional-transfer deduction columns never feed the tax deductions. A municipality-year-tax with an observed gross row but no deduction row counts the deduction as zero and computes net_revenue; deductions_reported records whether a deduction row existed in the source. Municipalities absent from a year's FINBRA file appear as non-reporters with reported=FALSE and NA tax and revenue values; population does not depend on reporting. population and the two revenue totals are the municipality-year context: population comes from IBGE (yearly estimates until 2021 and from 2024, the 2022 Census count, and a 2023 midpoint interpolation; FINBRA's População field is stale and lagged, so it is never used), it fills non-reporter rows too, and population_source records where it came from; both revenue totals are gross, before deductions, and the totals switch source for refreshed API years.

Columns

code_muni

Seven-digit IBGE municipality code, geobr-compatible.

abbrev_state

Two-letter state abbreviation as published by the source.

year

Exercise year, 2013 to the latest closed year.

population

Integer resident population from IBGE, independent of SICONFI reporting; repeated on both tax rows. The yearly estimate (SIDRA table 6579) for the other years, the 2022 Census count (table 4709) for 2022, and a 2023 midpoint between the 2022 Census and the 2024 estimate; NA when IBGE has no figure for the year. The 2022 Census count sits well below the 2021 estimate in many municipalities, so per-capita series break in 2022.

population_source

How population was obtained: estimate (yearly IBGE estimate, table 6579), census (2022 Census count, table 4709), or interpolated (2023 midpoint of the census and the 2024 estimate); NA when population is NA.

current_revenue

Gross realized total current revenue (Receitas Correntes) in nominal BRL for the municipality-year, before any deduction; repeated on both tax rows. From FINBRA, replaced by the API values for refreshed years; NA when the municipality reported but lacks the account line.

tax_revenue

Gross realized Impostos, Taxas e Contribuições de Melhoria (the whole tax group behind the IPTU and ITBI lines) in nominal BRL for the municipality-year, before deductions; repeated on both tax rows. From FINBRA, replaced by the API values for refreshed years; NA when the municipality reported but lacks the account line.

tax

Tax identifier: iptu or itbi.

reported

TRUE when the municipality appears in that year's data (FINBRA file or API refresh); non-reporters keep one NA row per tax.

value_status

observed (tax row present), missing_tax_row (the municipality reported but this tax has no gross row), or non_reporter (absent from the year's data).

gross_revenue

Realized gross tax-account value in nominal BRL; NA when the tax row is absent.

other_deductions

Non-FUNDEB, non-transfer tax deductions in nominal BRL; 0 when the municipality-year-tax has an observed gross row but no deduction row in the source, otherwise the observed value, kept even when the gross row is missing.

deductions_reported

TRUE when the source carried a deduction row for the municipality-year-tax; FALSE when only a gross row exists and the deduction is assumed 0; NA when the source has neither row.

net_revenue

Gross revenue minus deductions, rounded to cents, computed whenever the gross row exists (an assumed 0 deduction is subtracted).

account_scope

Account-vintage scope: legacy_line (IPTU and ITBI shown on separate account lines) through 2017, tax_family (post-2018 PCASP parents that fold in fines and old-debt lines) from 2018. Do not build a single constant-scope series across 2017-2018.

source

Row provenance: finbra (bulk-file history) or api (SICONFI API refresh of the latest years); NA for non-reporter rows.

See also
